scope: Selected nearby H I, He I and Ca lines from NIST Handbook Strong Lines tables, explicitly tabulated in air. This is not a comprehensive atomic/molecular line atlas, synthetic spectrum, abundance model or origin classification.
rule: Compare all95 CCF-corrected approximate stellar-air centers to the fixed reference table. Record nearest distance and whether it is within0.10Å as a descriptive positional flag only. Keep every95row; no likelihood, veto, detection change or chemical identity from a flag. Transitions may be absorption or emission depending on source conditions; handbook intensities do not predict stellar emission ratios.
reason: Distinguish familiar H/He/Ca reference locations from dense CN/CH-region stellar structure, and expose rather than hide chance atomic wavelength coincidences.
